description: This file contains custom commands for Cypress testing framework, including mocking API endpoints, login procedures, and seed data setup for the dashboard web application.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up mocked API endpoints for login, user management, report management, and charts data using Cypress intercepts.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Performs UI-based login by filling out login form and waiting for login request to complete.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Stores a fake JWT token directly into local storage to simulate logged-in state.
